title: Set up the equation
text: The amount changes by $$r$$ coming in minus $$d y$$ going out: $$y'=r-d y$$, with $$y(0)=0$$.

title: Separate and solve
text: Integrating both sides of $$\frac{dy}{r-d y}=dt$$ gives $$-\frac{1}{d}\ln|r-dy|=t+C$$ and using $$y(0)=0$$ and solving for $$y$$ gives $$y=\frac{r}{d} \left(1-e^{\left(-d t\right)}\right)$$.
